messages:
maya: heads-up: VeloxPay hitting bursts of 429s off dedicated pool eu-west-2-pool-7 since 01:03Z. Customers report intermittent latency spikes ~2-3s + a few 429s. Can SRE look?
samir: looking. any correlate with autoscaler events or noisy tenant spikes?
deploy-bot: autoscaler | eu-west-2-pool-7 | scale_up target=12 -> 18 @2035001125
deploy-bot: autoscaler | eu-west-2-pool-7 | scale_down target=18 -> 12 @2035001170
cheng: those scale events are ~45s apart. that's within cooldown. what's the metric? cpu? queue_length?
maya: attaching quick snapshot:
```json
{"time":"2035001100","cpu_pct":64,"request_q":3}
{"time":"2035001120","cpu_pct":95,"request_q":15}
{"time":"2035001165","cpu_pct":42,"request_q":2}
```
elaine: looks like a short burst pushed cpu to 95% then dropped; autoscaler saw spike and scaled, then metric smoothed and scaled down. classic jitter. is there per-tenant burst control on this pool?
samir: velox-pay has heavy batching patterns at 01:02Z -> lots of short lived KV cache invalidations. Also saw a tenant that kept submitting 8k token prompts every 10s (prob noisy neighbor).
maya: customer also called support; billing flagged an anomalous token usage spike for VeloxPay (possible retry storm).
cheng: quick repro steps: run a synthetic load replicating 10 r/s with 8k-token requests from a single tenant on pool eu-west-2-pool-7 for 2 minutes, watch autoscaler and queue length.
maya: logs excerpt from one host:
```
[2035001120] request start tenant=velox-pay model=gpt-large seq=8200
[2035001120] worker queue push len=16
[2035001121] worker cpu 94% kernel=high
[2035001165] processed batch size=1 latency=2800ms
```
samir: proposal: increase scale_down_grace to 180s and add hysteresis based on 2-min rolling avg + max_request_rate. Also add per-tenant admission control to throttle bursts.
elaine: can we instead set cooldown on that specific pool and pin VeloxPay to a dedicated subnet? that'd reduce noisy neighbor risk.
cheng: temporary mitigation: enable scale stabilization (min change interval 180s) on eu-west-2-pool-7 and set per-tenant burst token bucket to 5r/10s. I'll deploy the config; will report back.
maya: thanks. paging oncall to confirm we don't break SLAs: @oncall
oncall: saw config change, monitoring. I'll keep an eye. can you add a short alert for "rapid scale flip" (>=2 scale events in 2m)?
ops-bot: alert rule created: rapid_scale_flip_eu-west-2 threshold=2 window=120s
cheng: after change, we still need a root cause: reproduce with the synthetic load and collect per-host perf counters + KV cache hit rates. I'll take ownership of the repro run in 30m.
maya: ack. opened internal ticket INF-3421 and updated VeloxPay support thread with mitigation steps. thanks all :thumbsup:
